key.name: broker-url
key.description: URL of the MQTT broker for Media Utopia communication.

key.name: identity
key.description: Identity string sent to the MU daemon. If empty, hostname is used.

key.name: visualizer-enabled
key.description: Whether the audio visualizer is displayed on the Now Playing view.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Last saved window width in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last saved window height in pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the window was maximized when last closed.

key.name: active-renderer-id
key.description: The ID of the currently selected audio renderer.

key.name: close-to-tray
key.description: Whether closing the window hides to system tray instead of quitting.
